categories.title: Boss
categories.info: Bosses are fought at the end of specific chapters, and so are impossible to miss.

categories.title: Portal
categories.info: Portals are used to jump from one location to another, but must be activated on one end. Unlike with Doors, Luigi can carry objects through a Portal using the Poltergust.

categories.title: Secret Door
categories.info: Hidden doors that you need to reveal by doing a specific action, such as using the Darklight or removing an obstacle.

categories.title: Boo
categories.info: Boos are ghosts that hide in an object that is only invisible in a specific chapter. You need to collect all Boos in a mansion to unlock its Bonus stage.

categories.title: Gem
categories.info: Gems are found by investigating objects or completing specific tasks. Collect all of a mansion's gems to unlock a crystal statue in the Vault.

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: Treasure are sources of money, including Coins, Bills and Ingots. We only mark sources worth 40 Coins or more.

locations.title: Boolldog
locations.description: In the Underground Lab room, turn the valve with the Poltergust to zap the suit of armor and reveal this Boo.

locations.title: Boopa Troopa
locations.description: Fought mandatorily in E-2: Double Trouble.

locations.title: Booreaucrat
locations.description: In E-3: A Train to Catch, float up here using a Balloon Berry, then use the Golden Balloon Berry to collect all the Coins. This will reveal a chest with Booreaucrat in it.

locations.title: Big Boo
locations.description: Fought and captured mandatorily as part of E-4: Ambush Maneuver

locations.title: Maraboo

locations.title: Diamond #1
locations.description: In E-1: Front-Door Key, after revealing Boolldog in the Underground Lab, vacuum up the helmet and fire it at the glass jar on the right side of the room to get this Diamond.

locations.title: Diamond #2
locations.description:
In the second Hidden Catacombs, from the Underground Lab's door, follow the suits of armor right, forwards to the wall, then right again. Here you'll find the Diamond behind a wall of web.

To burn it down, continue back towards the camera, right, forwards to the back wall, then right. Here you'll find a painting of a ball of web. Use the Dark-Light on it to get a real one, light it with a torch, then return to the webs with the Diamond. Set them alight to free the Diamond!

locations.title: Diamond #3
locations.description: From [Diamond #2](#loc=384865), head forward towards the camera as far as you can, then head right and through the door to get to the Cliffside. You'll see the Diamond on the vines above: vacuum it down!

locations.title: Diamond #4
locations.description: In E-2: Double Trouble, shine the Dark-Light on the right-hand grotesque statue to reveal a chain to pull. Do this to reveal a safe under the stairs: open it with the Strobulb, then defeat the Empowered Slammer so you can claim the Diamond.

locations.title: Diamond #5
locations.description: Yank the chain of this toilet to eject the Diamond out of the toilet. Ew...

locations.title: Diamond #6
locations.description:
Get onto the Gargoyle Roof by vacuuming the [Mammoth Trunk](#loc=384891) in the Ice Age Exhibit. Here, you'll need to recover three stars and add them to the constellation:

- One is on the right in front of a grotesque statue.
- Another is in the mouth of a grotesque statue in the front-left corner. Flash it with the Strobulb.
- The third flies over the middle of the room: use the Poltergust to knock it off-course.

locations.title: Diamond #7
locations.description: Acquired by growing a wilted plant at this spot and then flashing it. To water it, take the [Water Bucket](#loc=384900) from the Dark Ages Exhibit, fill it with water in the Jungle Exhibit, then take it here.

locations.title: Diamond #8
locations.description: In E-3: A Train to Catch, tug both of the red sand bags on the hot air balloon to uncover the Gem. Beware: tugging the first one will release two Empowered Greenies and an Empowered Hider!

locations.title: Diamond #9
locations.description: Access by using one of the [Logs](#loc=384904) in the Jungle Exhibit to unlock the nearby [Secret Door](#loc=385026). Then, open the chest on the ship's bow.

locations.title: Diamond #10
locations.description: In the blue bookcase in E-3: A Train toe Catch. To lower it, grab a [Balloon Berry](#loc=385031) from the Study and use it to get the [Blue Book](#loc=385033) in the Front Entrance. Take the Blue Book and [portal](#loc=384888) over to the Dark Ages Exhibit and slot it into the bookshelf to reveal the Diamond.

locations.title: Diamond #11
locations.description: To get here, use a [Balloon Berry](#loc=385031) from the Study and float up to this extra floor of the Jungle Exhibit. Go to this spot and use the Gold Balloon Berry to collect all the Coins in time, revealing a chest with the Gem inside.

locations.title: Diamond #12
locations.description: In E-3: A Train to Catch, float up here using a Balloon Berry, then use the Golden Balloon Berry to grab all the Coins in time. This will spawn a chest with the Diamond in it.

locations.title: Diamond #13
locations.description: Shine the Dark-Light on the missing section of train tracks to have a train appear. Hop on it to collect the Diamond!

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description:
In the first Haunted Catacombs section, from the throne, head forward towards the camera all the way, then go right. On the back wall is a fake picture of a coffin: vacuum it to find a real one behind bars.

To get there, once again go all the way towards the camera and go right. Next, go forwards all the way to the back wall (past the two attacking suits of armor), then turn right to find the coffin and collect the three Gold Ingots.

locations.title: 150 G
locations.description: In E-3: A Train to Catch, a Golden Greenie can be found in this rocket. To get to it, take one of the [Logs](#loc=384904) from the Jungle Exhibit, light it with a torch from the Ancient Exhibit, then bring it here in the Space Exhibit to light the fuse. The rocket will take off: exit via the east door to hear it crash back down. Re-enter the room and catch the Golden Greenie!
